note: Kept by hand: one plain line per shipped feature, newest first. CHANGES shows it.

items.text: GRID: live 1D and 5D with minute bars; prices update every few seconds
GRAVEYARD: bigger stones, and every ticker easy to read
SPONSOR and BBRK: a big globe of visitors under the numbers
GRID: your own board of up to 16 mini charts, with a share link and card
WEIRD: a gauge with no data hides until it reports again
Command bar hints: a market command, then a fun one, in turn
Globe: drag to turn it, city dots, day and night, places live now pulse
PRO: a new page with your seat number, big; no SPONSORED BY for Pro
GRAVEYARD: a cemetery in sections by era, the last homepage, a timeline and video
SPONSOR: YOUR AD HERE, page views this week and N HERE NOW
WELCOME: a first-visit card with things to try and SURPRISE ME
DATA: sources in eight groups that open, simpler to read
GRAVEYARD: famous tickers that are gone, F to pay respects, ZOMBIES and ON THIS DAY
NO SUCH TICKER. YET.: did you mean, and IPO IT for a ticker nobody has
BBRK: our own site numbers, drawn like a quote screen
MCP: our public data for AI assistants, and the MCP command
SECTORS: periods, each sector's S&P 100 members, breadth and a map
$ and a ticker always means the stock: $GOLD, $M
Sponsor strip: one rotating line at the bottom of every screen
DATA, STATUS and CHANGES: every source, its licence and age in one table; the dot by the clock lists a screen's sources
SEC data is refetched when EDGAR shows a new filing; FINANCIALS numbers link to their filing
WHATIF: your own purchase of any stock, on a card of its own
WHATIF REPLAY: the race from the first buy to today, and SAVE VIDEO
WHATIF vices: beer, soda and chips priced from BLS average prices
NEWS and HOME: new stories arrive as they come, LIVE in the title strip
WHY: the 10 biggest daily moves of the year and what came out each day
GUESS: one mystery stock a day from its 1-year chart
SINCE on HOME: what moved since your last visit
WEIRD: period row, full-panel gauge charts and record lines
Chart N flags: headlines on 1D and 5D, other 8-Ks on daily charts
PRO: seats, yearly plan, gift codes, REDEEM, CHAT, SPONSOR and FEEDBACK
WORLDMAP: a dark world map of index moves, chokepoint ships and storms
FISHTANK: the S&P 100 as fish
ALERTS: price and gauge alerts, kept in this browser
TRENDING: the tickers people open most here
DESK: WEIRD gauges as cards and preset desks
WEIRD: 23 live odd-data gauges and share cards
Charts: 1-minute bars, zoom, measure, candles, volume, compare and event flags
NEWS tabs: MACRO, SEC, WIRES and WSB
Share cards for ticker screens and AFFORD
Type a company name or plain words and the right command runs
Money tools: WHATIF, AFFORD, LOAN and COMPOUND
Company screens: INSIDERS, OWNERS, FILINGS, SHORTS and BEATS
FINANCIALS: split-adjusted EPS and shares by default, AS REPORTED toggle
CRYPTO: top 20 without stablecoins and tokenised assets
MENU (Ctrl K), HELP directory and the function key bar
